business_purpose: Retain every source observation and preserve auditability
technical_logic: Load one Silver row per technical procurement_id; do not aggregate duplicate candidate business keys during Silver ingestion

technical_logic: Join on vendor_material_id; retain bridge vendor/material/plant and approval dates; reject or exception rows with no relationship

business_purpose: Expose the 198 documented vendor mismatches without overwriting source
technical_logic: Retain reported_vendor_id; set canonical_vendor_id from bridge; vendor_resolution_status = MATCH, MISMATCH, or UNRESOLVED
validation_query_or_method: Count p.vendor_id <> b.vendor_id; expected current evidence is 198 mismatch rows

business_purpose: Create a controlled currency key for EUR conversion
technical_logic: Retain original order_currency; map EURO to EUR only after approval; otherwise retain unresolved alias status and do not silently use contract currency
validation_query_or_method: Count EURO rows; current evidence is 188; compare normalized currency mapping to approved alias table
required_approval: Confirm EURO is a valid EUR alias

technical_logic: For approved currency mapping, eur_expenditure = order_value_local / units_per_eur; EUR uses rate 1; missing rate remains NULL with exception
validation_query_or_method: Validate from_currency=EUR and to_currency=order currency; recompute sample values; no fallback to contract currency
required_approval: Approve monthly average FX as a proxy and order_currency authority

technical_logic: Store applied rate, rate month, rate type, source label, and FX status on each converted row
validation_query_or_method: Validate one-to-one FX lookup after currency normalization and flag missing lookups

transformation_name: Standardize UOM only with approved factor
business_purpose: Prevent invalid quantity and price comparisons
technical_logic: Retain original UOMs; apply approved factor only for validated mappings; otherwise standardized quantities remain NULL and uom_conversion_status = PENDING/NOT_APPLICABLE
validation_query_or_method: Enumerate observed UOMs: base KG/PAA/SQM; PO KG/PAA/PCS/SQM; inspect PCS meaning and factor source
required_approval: Confirm PAA, PCS, KG, SQM meanings and conversion factors

business_purpose: Separate expenditure from comparable unit price
technical_logic: eur_unit_price = eur_expenditure / standardized_po_qty only when both are non-null and quantity > 0; otherwise NULL with price flag
validation_query_or_method: Test zero quantity, missing quantity, missing value, UOM mismatch, and currency exceptions
required_approval: Approve comparability gates for price analytics

business_purpose: Prevent accidental double counting while preserving legitimate observations
technical_logic: Group by vendor_material_id,month; retain all technical rows; assign duplicate_group_id and reconciliation_status; aggregate only after decision
validation_query_or_method: Current evidence: 157 repeated groups and 314 affected rows; inspect source IDs and value/quantity reconciliation
required_approval: Define duplicate reconciliation and aggregation policy

business_purpose: Distinguish no source row from explicit zero activity
technical_logic: Generate expected panel within approved relationship dates and source coverage; left join observations; set observation_status = OBSERVED, EXPLICIT_ZERO, or NO_SOURCE_ROW; do not impute spend
validation_query_or_method: Recalculate panel from approved_from and approved_to; current example VM00011 misses 2020-03-01 and other months
required_approval: Confirm whether absent activity is meaningful and panel end-date policy

business_purpose: Avoid false unit prices and silent imputation
technical_logic: Retain NULL and zero values; set zero_quantity_positive_spend, missing_quantity, and missing_value indicators
validation_query_or_method: Current examples: POA0001056 and POA0001265 zero quantity with positive spend; POA0001292 missing quantity; POA0000311 missing value

business_purpose: Preserve operational exceptions for later business interpretation
technical_logic: Do not cap, replace, or net quantities; classify negative GR and GR greater than PO with flags and retain original values
validation_query_or_method: Validate DQ03 and DQ04 counts and inspect UOM/timing context
required_approval: Approve treatment of timing, returns, and reversals

business_purpose: Avoid procurement fanout and unsupported KPI weighting
technical_logic: First reconcile repeated vendor-plant-quarter rows; publish one approved quarterly row only after weighting method and denominator are confirmed
validation_query_or_method: Current evidence: 14,661 repeated keys and 78,003 excess rows; inspect delivery_lines range for vendor 100114/plant 1006/2020-01-01
required_approval: Approve delivery_lines weighting and repeated-row reconciliation

technical_logic: Use only approved mappings; validate weight denominator before weighted index calculation; preserve missing index prices as exceptions
validation_query_or_method: Validate weight totals and six documented missing index_price rows
required_approval: Confirm weight semantics and missing index treatment

technical_logic: Publish expenditure where source value and FX are valid; publish unit price only when currency, UOM, quantity, and duplicate status pass gates
validation_query_or_method: Run readiness checks before each Gold price table refresh
